summary: First session of test fixes for the whole PRD. It raised both high-risk rows, AC-ASK-03 and AC-ASK-04, from Weak to Adequate, and a fresh reviewer confirmed both grades. New tests cover a bare repository or a folder inside a checkout given as the answer, worktree and wrong-origin answers refused end to end with nothing remembered, and a fresh search after a remembered folder fails. Each new test was seen to fail with the behavior broken. The full suite is green. 11 Weak rows remain in test-audit.md, starting with AC-SEE-05.

settled.how: AC-ASK-03 is now Adequate (10 of 10 stated parts) at a802a4d. New tests cover a bare repository and a folder inside a checkout, plus worktree and wrong-origin answers refused end to end with nothing remembered. Each was seen red and re-graded by a fresh reviewer.

AC-ASK-04 is now Adequate (5 of 5) at a802a4d. A new test proves that after a remembered folder fails, Kiln forgets it, searches again and uses a checkout the search reaches. It was seen red and re-graded by a fresh reviewer.
